title: Boccaccio
writer: Mario Amendola, Giovanni Boccaccio, Bruno Corbucci
actors: Enrico Montesano, Sylva Koscina, Pascale Petit
plot: Buffalmacco and his friend Bruno Degli Olivieri make a joke of Calandrino, forcing him, for ten florins, to buy a stone that should make invisible the one who owns it.
